# Fraud checks

## Goal

Score every order before capture and hold the risky ones for review.

## Checklist

- [x] Risk score client
- [x] Hold queue in the admin panel
- [x] Alerts for the support team
- [ ] Threshold tuning with the risk team
- [ ] Load test at 2x Black Friday

## Decisions

- Orders above score 80 are held, never auto-cancelled.
